topic: The tool hooks can be turned off in orch settings
detail: pre-tool-use and cwd-changed are Claude Code hooks like the others, so `orch settings` can turn them off (install then leaves them alone and status shows the harness's tool hooks as missing, a warning). That silently stops the command log and, after SP-041, the guard. Decide whether SP-042 (self-protection) or SP-070 (operator-only switches) should stop them from being toggled, or make turning them off operator-only.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: the tool hooks become an operator-only SP-070 switch; see D-40 and SP-070.1.a4.
